question_text: Obtain an expression for the kinetic energy of a body rolling without slipping.

verification.note: PREDICTED — Session 89 enumeration sweep (archetype × object grid over the NCERT chapter): this question has not appeared in any paper or source book we hold, but the chapter contains it and the 2-mark/4-mark format admits it. Authored as a lean card; promote to a full card when a paper season or a Telangana IPE teacher validates the cell. Split invented, as everywhere.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.label: The two motions
lines: A rolling body does two things at once:
its centre of mass moves forward with
speed v, and the body rotates about the
centre with angular velocity ω = v/R.
steps.why: Rolling IS translation plus rotation; the no-slipping condition v = Rω is the lock between them.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the no-slip condition, which leaves ω unrelated to v.

recall.must_convey: That rolling is translation of the CM plus rotation with omega = v by R.
reject: half m v squared plus half I omega squared

steps.memory_tip: At the contact point the two speeds cancel, and that is exactly what no slipping means.
steps.margin_note: First mark. Name both motions and write the no-slip link v = Rω.

lines: Each motion carries its own kinetic
Substituting I = mk² and ω = v/R,
steps.why: The bracket [1 + k²/R²] is the fingerprint of the body: ½ more for a disc, 2/5 more for a sphere — one formula, every shape.
common_mistakes: Adding the energies with different speeds — the SAME v appears in both after the substitution.

recall.must_convey: That KE is half m v squared plus half I omega squared, giving the bracket 1 + k squared by R squared.
accept: half m v squared plus half I omega squared
one plus k squared by R squared

steps.memory_tip: k²/R² is the shape number: 1 for a ring, ½ for a disc, 2/5 for a solid sphere.
steps.margin_note: Two marks. Write the two energies separately, then substitute I = mk² and ω = v/R.

steps.label: The result
lines: Rolling always carries MORE energy than
steps.why: The closing sentence is the physical content: some of the work done on a rolling body hides in the spin.
common_mistakes: Claiming a rolling and a sliding body at the same v have the same energy.

recall.must_convey: That KE of rolling = half m v squared times 1 + k squared by R squared, more than sliding.

steps.memory_tip: The 1 in the bracket is the sliding part; the k²/R² is the extra energy stored in the spin.
steps.margin_note: Final mark. Box the formula, then add the one-line comparison with sliding.

insider_note: Both halves must appear before the bracket: ½mv² and ½Iω² carry 2 of the 4 marks, and ω = v/R is what joins them.
